speaker: Doctor
text: How long has the swelling and pain in your right ring finger been progressing?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds like a significant injury. Did the finger appear deformed or deviated immediately after the incident, or was it straight when you first noticed the swelling?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger (Avulsion fracture of the distal phalanx).

The inability to actively flex the DIP joint, combined with the specific mechanism of forced extension and subsequent swelling, is classic for a mallet finger injury. REQUEST IMAGES: X-Ray Right Hand AP and Lateral views.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
